Mod.title: Tier One Overhaul
Mod.author: Fluffy
Mod.description:
[h1]Back by Popular demand, The Fabled Tier One Overhaul.[/h1]
[i]I need to Level with you guys here[/i] It was an [u]undertaking[/u] and a half to Port this to [b]1.0[/b], This mod has changed hands [b]twice[/b] and I got dealt a pretty bad hand with 1.0's changes.
I thought to myself [quote=Fluffy]How Hard could it really be?[/quote] [u][i]It was in fact Hard[/i][/u]
[b]Several Thousand[/b] Lines of XML later here we are.
Please be Patient and Report any Issues you Run into. I tried my Best to make it not overwrite things as much as I can and to make sure all the Classes have most of the Equipment they had before if they are missing anything big let me know and I will look into it.
To get to the [i]Nitty Gritty[/i], I have [b]fundamentally[/b] changed the way [b][u]Tier One Overhaul[/u][/b] works. It doesn't overwrite the Vanilla Rangers at all, It may add equipment to them and the other Squads, But it doesn't remove any or Overwrite any.
When you go to make a Squad you will find a separate Tier One Rangers that you can create instead.
NSWDG is still here too, I'm not super confident in their Equipment Binds but It seems to be in order from what I can tell.
[u]Doctrines, Doctrines, Doctrines.[/u] I'm sorry to disappoint but Neither of the Squads have Doctrines, It is just too much of a hassle for me to reliably copy from the rangers to the Tier one group given how deep the Changes Tier One Makes are.
Will they come later, Maybe but don't get your Hopes up.
Original Nexus Description: Nearly full overhaul of the game. Adds new weapons, attack types, equipment, units, and more.
NEW UNIT: NSW Development Group -x4 Assaulter -x2 Support -x2 Marksman -x1 Undercover -x1 Black Ops
NEW WEAPONS: -HK MP7A2 -MCX Rattler -Noveske Gen III 10.5" -HK416D 10.4" -Mk17 Custom -Mk46 Mod 1 -Mk11 Mod 1 -Mk12 Mod 1 -Mk13 Mod 5 -M320 GLM(HE/HEDP/CS/Smoke) -Milkor M32 MGL(Smoke) -FN40GL Mk2(Smoke) -Weapon descriptions provided by dps524 -3D model for M320 provided by nachomacho -Smoke GLs suggested by Ryuk
NEW EQUIPMENT: -GPNVG-18(White Phosphor) by jacob- -Suicide Bomb(NWS Militia)
COSMETICS: -Custom Helmets(AOR1/MC) by jacob- -Custom Uniforms(AOR1/MC)
